text:
margo-partnerships: Partner (SnowBridge) requested tenant-scoped sandbox for a marketplace demo. They want per-tenant entitlements + rotating coauth tokens. Can we support by end of next week?
raj-security: short: we need a threat assessment. Rotating tokens are fine but must be KMS-backed and auditable. What rotation window are they asking for?
lina-product: They're asking for 24h tokens to support long-running ingest jobs in the demo. Is 24h something we can allow for marketplace sandboxes?
raj-security: 24h is risky for a public marketplace. Recommend 4h TTL with a refresh flow + refresh token. Also require separate audit logs per tenant and token revocation endpoint. :lock:
tom-engplatform: We can add rotation support in the private token service. Rough estimate: 3 working days for proto + 1 day testing. Need a schema for entitlement flags (compute_access, telemetry_sharing, demo_mode).
margo-partnerships: OK can we aim for 4h tokens + refresh? Partner also wants a sample data sandbox with PII redaction and exports disabled (no delta exports).
jess-legal: We'll need a DPA addendum before sharing partner sample data and for marketplace listing. I'll draft template language. Partners must sign data processing terms and confirm retention limits.
raj-security: Also add per-tenant rate-limits and request quotas. If they need higher throughput for demos, we should recommend Dedicated or reserved pilot slots.
lina-product: For the public demo pass, product asks for limited telemetry so we can show latency numbers. Telemetry must be opt-in for partner sandboxes.
partner-bot: @margo thanks — preference is 24h but we can accept 4h if refresh is seamless. Also we need test creds for Databricks connector validation and vector DB write tests.
margo-partnerships: Tom, can the connector-proxy generate short-lived Databricks creds per tenant? Ideally ephemeral tokens with audit trail.
tom-engplatform: Yes — connector-proxy can mint per-tenant ephemeral credentials if partner provides a service principal + scopes. We then attach TTL and audit entries.
raj-security: We'll require certificate pinning for the connector handshake and list required scopes: files:read, jobs:submit, tokens:manage. Also require connector healthcheck endpoint on partner side.
lina-product: Can ops add a 'demo-mode' toggle to automatically mask PII in the sample dataset? Product wants pseudonymization (not full synthetic) for fidelity.
emily-ops: ops: we'll add a demo-mode toggle. Masking rules: regex-based redaction + deterministic pseudonyms for names/email, and block delta-exports. We'll provide a small script to reproduce masking.
margo-partnerships: Action items: 1) Tom to prototype 4h rotation + per-tenant creds. 2) Raj to produce security checklist + required scopes. 3) Jess to draft DPA addendum for sample data. 4) Lina to write demo-mode masking spec and provide sample dataset. 5) Margo to coordinate partner comms and timeline. Friday check-in 10:00am PT.
tom-engplatform: I'll open an RFC/PR today and link when ready. Planning to use:``
# token rotation pseudo
POST /internal/token/mint
{ "tenant_id": "T-123", "scopes": ["connector:write"], "ttl_s": 14400 }

// response contains ephemeral token + refresh token
```
raj-security: I'll post the checklist doc link when it's ready and include revocation endpoints and monitoring alerts.
jess-legal: I'll circulate the DPA draft by Thursday EOD for review.
margo-partnerships: Thanks all — will start partner comms after legal + security thumbs up. :thumbsup:
